import Mathlib

theorem epsilonImplications :
    ∀ a b x : ℝ,
      ((∀ ε > 0, x < a + ε) → x ≤ a) ∧
      ((b > 0 ∧ ∀ ε > 0, x < a + b * ε) → x ≤ a) ∧
      ((∀ ε > 0, x > a - ε) → x ≥ a) ∧
      ((b > 0 ∧ ∀ ε > 0, x > a - b * ε) → x ≥ a) ∧
      ((∀ ε > 0, |x - a| < ε) → x = a) ∧
      ((b > 0 ∧ ∀ ε > 0, |x - a| < b * ε) → x = a) := by
